S1952: The important correction is that we should **stop treating the work as one linear theory-development chain**. Step 282 has already established the crucial stopping point ... From here onward, the work separates into certification and architecture streams.
S2195: 5.18 is surprisingly relevant ... structural identity ≠ semantic equivalence ≠ numerical identity ... this does not resolve anything [because Steps 285-290 have already established the equality problem independently].
